## Definition of Done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria pass as automated tests; story/NFR IDs are in the test titles
- [ ] `npm run verify` and `npm run test:e2e` pass locally
- [ ] No figure is defaulted, estimated or interpolated; missing data fails loudly
- [ ] Reconciliation tolerance not widened; no check weakened to make something pass
- [ ] Any new rule states its evidence and observation count (and is in `src/domain/rules.ts`)
- [ ] UI changes: keyboard-only walkthrough done; status is text + icon, not colour alone; checked at 360 px
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/requirements.md`, ADR if a decision changed, `CHANGELOG.md`)
- [ ] No new dependency — or it is justified below
